verdicts.reason: A keeps the yellow LOVE. CARE. KIDS. block and the mother-and-baby photo, but the photo is shrunk to a tiny thumbnail jammed against the right edge. A wide empty white gap separates it from the headline, so the banner reads as two scattered fragments, and the thin yellow frame is gone. B centres the headline block but shrinks the key photo to an unrecognisable sliver at the far left and adds a stray yellow fragment in the top-right corner, so the core imagery is lost and the layout reads as broken.
